ns2:course.label: Leadership Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Intermediate level practical application of military skills and leadership; includes mountaineering and rappelling, first aid, small unit marching, weapons firing, and physical fitness. Field trip required. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For second-year military science students. Attendance at physical training three days per week.
